title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Town Hall front-of-room view control (Worldwide)
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap scope and dates, attendee-view default, Pro entitlement, and both governance control surfaces are supported. Microsoft's support page confirms the presenter-display exposure, and the briefing reports the differing roadmap and release-note timelines rather than treating either as a commitment.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap and Town Hall release-note entry name no administrator enablement step or setting to choose the default front-of-room view.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android Town Hall front-of-room view control administrator default view setting enable policy. Read roadmap, rooms-release-note, set-up-events, Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy and linked MTR support page; no such enablement or default-view setting found.

claims.claim: Presenter view shows the Manage screen queue on the front-of-room display.
claims.quote: It will also show the Manage screen queue where presenters are brought on and off screen

claims.claim: Presenter view shows a red square around the live feed indicating what attendees currently see.
claims.quote: as well as a red square around the live feed to indicate what attendees are currently seeing.

claims.claim: Microsoft advises attendee view to hide presenter controls when presenters and attendees share the room.
claims.quote: If you're in an MTR where both presenters and attendees are present, switch to Attendee view to hide the presenter controls on the front display.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter and cost
claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor the release notes names a meter for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android Front-of-room view control Town Hall feature meter billing charge Teams Rooms Pro. Read roadmap, Town Hall release-note entry and rooms-licensing; Pro entitlement is stated, but no meter is named for view control.

claims.claim: The control is in Teams admin center at Meetings > Events policies > policy > Events optimized for a large audience.
claims.quote:
go to Meetings > Events policies.
Select an existing policy or create a new one.
For events optimized for large audiences, such as town halls, turn the Events optimized for a large audience toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTownhalls Disabled disables creation of events optimised for large audiences.
claims.quote:
-AllowTownhalls
This setting governs if a user can create an event optimized for large audiences using Teams Events.
Disabled: Disables the Optimize for Large Audience option for organizers scheduling an event.
-Identity
Unique identifier assigned to the Teams Events policy.

claims.claim: The events policy is user-scoped.
claims.quote: User-level policy for tenant admin to configure options for customizing Teams events experiences. Use this cmdlet to update an existing policy.

claims.claim: Events optimized for a large audience controls whether organisers with the policy can create such events, including Town Halls.
claims.quote: | Events optimized for a large audience (On,Off) | -AllowTownhalls (Enabled,Disabled) | Controls whether users with this policy can create events optimized for large audiences, such as town halls. |

claims.claim: The documented events creation policy governs scheduling, not the front-of-room view.
claims.quote: Controls whether users with this policy can create events optimized for large audiences, such as town halls.

claims.claim: Changing the setting to Off after an event is scheduled prevents the user from running or starting it.
claims.quote: If you change the value to Off after a user schedules an event, they can't run or start the event.

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference describes the events policy as still in preview.
claims.quote: This cmdlet allows you to configure options for customizing Teams events experiences. Note that this policy is currently still in preview.

claims.claim: The release notes say Town Hall presenter support and view control are available with direct console connection.
claims.quote: Presenter support for Teams Town Hall and Front-of-room view control for Teams Town Hall are available with direct console connection.
